$comment: The covers the platform register shows each game by. These are DERIVATIVES: each is a 900px JPEG re-encoded from that game's own key art, because a register that lists every game would otherwise carry several megabytes of PNG before it said a word. The re-encode drops the C2PA chunk and the invisible watermark, which is why sourceSha256 is recorded — the provenance of these files is the provenance of the file each came from. Where an entry needed more than the shared recipe it carries its own `derivation`. The catalogue that names them is src/art/titles.ts; nothing else in this repository spells these paths.
disclosure: Every image here is AI-generated, and not all by the same model — each asset names its own provider. Each source file carries C2PA provenance and an invisible watermark; the JPEGs served here are re-encoded derivatives and carry neither, so each one names the file it came from and that file's checksum.
licence: cloudsforge-generated: commercial use permitted; AI-generated, C2PA provenance retained by the source
